# Matheus Abrahão

> Shopify expert and e-commerce engineer with 6+ years on Shopify. Started with his own store (Martin, martin4shop.com.br) and grew into running Shopify operations for international brands. Currently operates paired B2C and B2B Shopify storefronts — one enterprise-scale catalog with multi-level variants — for a US building-products manufacturer. Drove +455% sessions, +114% orders and +74% revenue for an international luxury fashion brand, and +254% sales, +324% orders and +1,700% sessions for a US-based beauty and lifestyle brand. Works remotely from Brazil (UTC-3) with e-commerce brands in the United States and Canada.

Shopify Expert e engenheiro de e-commerce. Trabalha remotamente para marcas nos EUA e Canadá. Especialista em Shopify Plus e Liquid, Matrixify, Salsify PIM, Klaviyo, SEO técnico, otimização de velocidade e migrações para Shopify.

## What He Does

- Shopify theme and Liquid development — custom sections, PDP and collection engineering, checkout extensibility, B2B storefronts
- Catalog operations at scale — Matrixify bulk imports and exports, multi-level variants, pricing and inventory sync, Salsify PIM syndication
- Klaviyo email and SMS — flow architecture, segmentation, list health, Shopify data integration, revenue attribution
- Shopify speed optimization — Core Web Vitals, third-party script audits, theme and image optimization
- Technical SEO for Shopify — crawlability and canonical fixes, duplicate and filter URL handling, index bloat, structured data and schema markup, robots.txt.liquid and sitemaps, collection architecture, internal linking
- GEO / AEO — generative and answer engine optimization: llms.txt, AI crawler access, and content structured so ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews cite a store accurately
- Shopify migrations — WooCommerce, Wix, Magento and BigCommerce to Shopify with data integrity and SEO-safe redirects

## Proof

- Operates paired B2C and B2B Shopify storefronts for a US building-products manufacturer — enterprise-scale catalog, multi-level variants, 7+ sales channels
- +455% sessions, +114% orders, +74% revenue for an international luxury fashion brand, as sole engineer
- +254% sales, +324% orders, +1,700% sessions in 12 months for a US-based beauty and lifestyle brand
- Catalog syndication to Lowe's, Home Depot (US and Canada), Menards and Amazon Seller and Vendor Central via Salsify PIM and Matrixify, with MAP/MSRP pricing parity across channels
- Founder of Martin (martin4shop.com.br), his own Shopify store: 1,959 orders, roughly R$552,000 processed, and 299,000+ sessions, operated end-to-end as a single founder
- Apple Swift Student Challenge 2026 — global winner (technical credibility; his professional work is Shopify)

## Articles

- [How I Drove +455% Sessions and +74% Sales on a Luxury Shopify Store](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/scalable-ecommerce-shopify-react) (2026-05-02): A breakdown of the technical SEO, catalog data, and automation playbook I used as the sole engineer for an international luxury fashion brand on Shopify Plus.
- [The Matrixify Playbook: Bulk Catalog Operations Without Breaking Production](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-catalog-matrixify-playbook) (2026-04-18): A field guide to running large Shopify bulk imports with Matrixify and CSV workflows — versioning, validation, rollback, and the conventions that keep multi-variant catalogs sane.
- [Technical SEO for AI Search: Making Your Shopify Store Readable to ChatGPT, Claude & Perplexity](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/technical-seo-ai-search-shopify) (2026-04-02): A practical guide to schema markup, llms.txt, structured data, and site architecture that makes your Shopify store surface in AI-powered search and conversational answers.
- [Matrixify: The Field Guide to Shopify Bulk Operations at Scale](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/matrixify-shopify-bulk-operations-guide) (2026-08-28): Six years of running Matrixify on production Shopify stores — export discipline, import commands, cross-store sync, dry runs, rollback files, and the failure modes nobody warns you about.
- [Retail Syndication: Getting Product Data Accepted by Lowe's, Home Depot and Menards](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/retail-syndication-salsify-lowes-home-depot) (2026-08-27): How product data actually flows from Shopify through a PIM like Salsify out to Lowe’s, Home Depot, Menards and Amazon — attribute requirements, image specs, rejection reasons, and keeping one source of truth.
- [Shopify Speed Optimization: What Actually Moved Core Web Vitals on a 13,000-Variant Catalog](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-speed-optimization-core-web-vitals) (2026-08-26): A real Shopify speed optimization audit — lab score 31, field CWV passing. Duplicate tags, render-blocking consent scripts, LCP priority hints, and the fixes that were worth shipping.
- [Klaviyo Expert Field Notes: 11 Flow Defects That Quietly Kill Email Revenue](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/klaviyo-expert-flow-audit) (2026-08-24): Real Klaviyo flow defects found in a production audit — broken dynamic coupons, SMS/email branching bugs, dead conversion metrics, UTM fragmentation — and how flow revenue recovered to ~$15.8K in 7 days.
- [Shopify B2B Wholesale Alongside B2C: Running Two Storefronts on One Catalog](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-b2b-wholesale-alongside-b2c) (2026-08-22): How to run a Shopify B2B wholesale storefront next to a consumer store — MAP vs MSRP pricing, customer tagging, trade tiers, catalog sync, checkout differences, and the price-leakage problem nobody mentions.
- [Shopify Migration Expert Notes: Moving URLs Without Losing SEO](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-migration-expert-seo-redirects) (2026-08-20): The redirect ordering rule Shopify does not document, URL inventories, rollback asymmetry, and what a platform migration leaves behind years later. Field notes from repeatable Shopify migrations.
- [Shopify Multichannel: Syncing 7+ Sales Channels Without Breaking the Catalog](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-multichannel-inventory-sync) (2026-08-18): Replacing an 18MB Excel macro with a real inventory pipeline — Amazon Seller and Vendor Central, Google Merchant Center, dropship networks, and why every channel has a different key column.
- [Shopify SMS Marketing: Building Consent-Safe SMS and Email Retention That Compounds](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-sms-marketing-retention) (2026-08-16): How to build a Shopify SMS marketing program that is TCPA-defensible — one canonical opt-in form, nine capture surfaces, verbal double opt-in, and why SMS must be additive to email, never instead of it.
- [Shopify Custom Reports: Turning GA4 and Sales Data Into Decisions, Not Dashboards](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/shopify-custom-reports-ga4-analytics) (2026-08-14): Store owners do not need another pretty dashboard — they need to know which decision to make. How I build custom Shopify reports joining GA4, order data and catalog exports into merchandising and upsell calls.
- [How I Took a Small Shopify Store to +1,700% Sessions and +254% Sales in 12 Months](https://www.matheusabrahao.com.br/blog/scaling-small-shopify-store-sessions-revenue) (2026-08-12): A US beauty and lifestyle brand went from a quiet Shopify store to US$207.3K in sales, +324% orders and 51.5K sessions in twelve months. The stack, the sequence, and why the same method worked on three very different stores.
